nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What I'm trying to say is that $ZOE was really looking forward to seeing her parents again. She got her hopes up, and then they let her down... `Again.`

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't know about you, Howard, but I'm not going to take it anymore. We need to do something!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You're right! $ZOE's parents might be okay with ruining $ZOE's Christmas, but that doesn't mean `we` have to accept it!

nodes.text: Great! So here's what we do!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We hijack a cargo plane, kidnap $ZOE's parents, and smuggle them back to Centerscore wrapped inside large, festively-wrapped presents...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay, well, that's... A thought...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But I think I have a better idea. When we were talking, $ZOE mentioned a few things she treasured about Christmas...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay, and those things were?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Snow, a real tree, and a charm for her charm bracelet...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I think if we can get those three things, it won't matter if $ZOE's parents can make it to Centerscore or not...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE can still have the best Christmas ever!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, so? The `president` is busy, too, and his kids live in the White House, right?
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, so? The [color=#3b78e2][i]president[/i][/color] is busy, too, and his kids live in the White House, right?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: ...I guess I never thought of it like that.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, you would think that, Howard. You're a sweet guy, and you always look for the best in people.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's one of the reasons $ZOE likes you, and it's one of the reasons I think you're perfect for her.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You do? I mean, well... That's good, right?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sure, it's good, but it also means that sometimes you miss things that are obvious to everyone else.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Don't take this the wrong way, Howard, but I'm worn out, and I want to lie down for a bit. Can we talk again later?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: ...Sure. Whatever you need.
Howard plants a quick kiss on $ZOE's cheek and leaves the bedroom.
As Howard walks toward the door, Sam steps in front of him.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `That's it?`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]That's it?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait... What's it...?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Your girlfriend is behind that door, having the worst Christmas of her life, and you're just going to walk away?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No! I mean, I would never...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: The thing is $ZOE asked me to go. She wanted to be alone.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh. Listen to yourself, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You've been dating $ZOE long enough to know that she doesn't always know what she wants, especially not when it comes to her parents.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Don't you remember what happened at Thanksgiving? What kind of parents abandon their kid for two holidays in a row?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, I guess I always assumed they were...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's a family tradition, Howard. They're `supposed` to be dull.
nodes.text_bbcode: It's a family tradition, Howard. They're [color=#3b78e2][i]supposed[/i][/color] to be dull.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Right, but...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, Howard. You don't get it because you've spent every holiday you can remember with your family...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The thing is, while family traditions are happening, you don't appreciate them, but once they're gone... You realize how much they meant.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: ...Right.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah. It's funny, isn't it? You look back, and sometimes it's the quiet moments that mean the most.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, with Kay and Kel in the house, I'd have to agree with `that` sentiment.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, with Kay and Kel in the house, I'd have to agree with [color=#e23b3b][i]that[/i][/color] sentiment.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Aww, Howard. I knew you'd understand.

Just then, Howard's cell phone rings...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh, hello?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard... Sniffle... Do you think you could come over? I really need someone to talk to right now.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sure, $ZOE, of course. I'll be right over.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: You will? But we're supposed to be spending time together.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I know, and I'm sorry, Mom, but this sounds really important!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE? Are you...?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE, what's the matter?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sniffle... I just got an email from my parents, and they're not going to be able to make it back from Europe for the holidays.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh no!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sniffle... I just feel so sad, Howard... I guess I just needed a hug.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, well, I've got plenty of those.
Howard pulls $ZOE close and kisses her tenderly.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm sorry about your parents not being able to make it back to Centerscore. I know you were looking forward to seeing them again...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Especially after what happened at Thanksgiving...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Aunt Cathy and Sam have been really good to me, so I know I shouldn't complain, but...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't help it... I miss my mom and dad.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess I just thought if they could make it back for Christmas, then things would be the way they used to be...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There'd be snow outside, a real tree in the living room, and I'd open up my first present, and it would be a new charm for my charm bracelet.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: See? This charm's a pony to commemorate the year I started horseback riding lessons...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And this one's a book to commemorate the year I learned how to read...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Heh, those are pretty cute!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So you're saying every year you and your family did the same basic thing? That sounds pretty...

nodes.text: Really? It looks a little large to me, but then again, I also know you kids today just love your baggy clothes.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh, actually, I was just trying to be nice. I really think...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Well, regardless, if `you're` satisfied, I won't take it back to the store and swap it out for a medium. You can keep it just the way it is!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, regardless, if [color=#3b78e2][i]you're[/i][/color] satisfied, I won't take it back to the store and swap it out for a medium. You can keep it just the way it is!

nodes.speaker: Howard

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Oh, I know, but I just loved the color, and the clerk promised I could exchange it for a smaller size right after the holidays if I needed to.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, well, in that case, I like it a lot! I'll just, y'know, make sure to leave the tags on.

nodes.text_bbcode: Did she now? Well, I [color=#e23b3b][i]may[/i][/color] know a place. You guys good to take a stroll through the woods?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sure!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt?! Is that sweater stolen?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I thought we talked about this!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey, it's the thought that counts, right?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, and I'm `thinking` about you going back to boot camp every time a holiday rolls around...
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, and I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]thinking[/i][/color] about you going back to boot camp every time a holiday rolls around...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: ...I guess stealing is a pretty sore subject...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look, it's for Maddie...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Do you think your little sister wants you to disappear again? Don't you think she'd rather have you than a sweater?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: ...Colt has a sister?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Fine, I'll return it! But the next time you bring Captain Howdy here, tell him to mind his own business!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: ...Sorry. We only came because we need your help.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: My help, huh? This ought to be good. What do you need?
Sam lays out the situation.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, I `may` know a place we can get a tree. You guys good to take a stroll through the woods?
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, I [color=#e23b3b][i]may[/i][/color] know a place we can get a tree. You guys good to take a stroll through the woods?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay, that seems easy enough! I mean, buying a real Christmas tree at Christmas can't be too hard, right?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Actually, we were hoping we could borrow the snow machine you used at last year's Winter Formal...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: ...Really? I mean, I `guess` that'd be okay, but aren't you worried? Snow machines are seriously bad news...
nodes.text_bbcode: ...Really? I mean, I [color=#e23b3b][i]guess[/i][/color] that'd be okay, but aren't you worried? Snow machines are seriously bad news...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I mean, the last time I used one, it really put the 'cold' in cold shoulder...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks for the warning, but I think we'll take our chances...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Okay, well, if you're willing to risk it...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Just remember to be careful transporting it. Snow machines tend to turn over when they get moved, and if that happens...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well, you won't let that happen, right?
A few minutes later, the snow machine is stowed in the back seat of Howard's SUV...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Remember what $Scott said. You'll need to drive carefully.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I know how to drive, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I know. I'm just saying the roads could be icy or...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Heh. Just buckle up. I've got everything under control.
Howard throws his car into gear and revs out of the parking lot.

nodes.prompt: Watch the road! Don't lose control!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Look, it doesn't matter whether Angie believes in giving gifts or not.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: ...It doesn't?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No, that paper demonstrates that Angie respects a variety of holiday traditions. If yours includes swapping presents, you can be sure she'll be cool with that.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yeah, that's pretty smart!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Besides... What girl doesn't like getting gifts?
Angie peeks her head into the gym. $Scott walks over, swaps presents with Angie, and then gives her a big kiss.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Tee hee! Not in public, $Scott! You'll make me blush!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Sorry. Couldn't help myself.
A few minutes later, $Scott walks back over.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Thanks again for the sound advice. Now, did you guys need something?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: So you're saying I should wait to see what Angie does and then follow her lead?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, pretty much!
Angie peeks her head into the gym. $Scott walks over to her. The two face each other, but neither one makes the first move.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: ...So what's up?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: ...Why don't you tell me?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: ...You asked me to meet you here, didn't you?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: ...Did I?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: ...Okay, well, I can tell now isn't a good time. Maybe we can talk later.
Angie exits the gym. $Scott trudges despondently back over.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: It's too bad she wasn't into  giving presents. I think Angie really would've liked the trendy, calculator button necklace I got her.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Anyway, did you guys need something?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So, we're giving up?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, I don't know, Howard. The first two items on the list seemed pretty doable, but this...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh, Howard. This was a waste of time. We didn't get any of the items on the list.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, well... I wish things had gone better, but it's the `thought` that counts, right?
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, well... I wish things had gone better, but it's the [color=#e23b3b][i]thought[/i][/color] that counts, right?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: ...Yeah, you just keep telling yourself that.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Howard, I care for $ZOE, too, but this plan doesn't seem to be working. Maybe we should think of something else...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No! We're not stopping now...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: ...Fine. What's next then?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hm... Next, we should get the...
Next, we should get the...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Okay, where should we start?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hm... First, I think we should get the...
Jared leaps onto the rear bumper of a moving truck and vanishes down the street!

nodes.speaker: Natara Williams
nodes.text: Why are you stopping? He's getting away!

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: We're not going to catch him on foot. Best we can do now is put out an APB.
You tackle Jared, smashing him into the curb!
Detective Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: Gotcha!

nodes.speaker: Jared
nodes.text: Aaaaagh! Get off me, pig!

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: You better have the world's best alibi lined up for last night... Or you are in a world of trouble!

nodes.speaker: Jared
nodes.text: I'm not saying anything until I talk to my lawyer!
A few minutes later, you and Natara stand on the sidewalk. Uniformed officers have taken Jared down to the station.

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: That was a pretty close call with that bus.

nodes.speaker: Natara Williams
nodes.text: Yeah, I... It was...

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: You doing all right, Special Agent?

nodes.speaker: Natara Williams
nodes.text: I... I am. Thank you, Detective.

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: Please. Call me Mal.

nodes.text: Up ahead, Jared keeps running.
You grab Natara by her jacket and pull her back just in time! The bus blasts its horn as it flies by!

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: You all right?

nodes.speaker: Natara Williams
nodes.text: I'm good, but... He's getting away!
You propel Natara and yourself forward, shooting past the bus!

nodes.speaker: Natara Williams
nodes.text: Thanks for the assist.
Natara skids on her heels and propels herself backwards. Her wrist whacks against the side of the bus!

nodes.speaker: Natara Williams
nodes.text: Ow!
The two of you sprint towards Jared! He spins around desperately, then darts into the street!

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: He's crazy!
Horns blare and bellow! An SUV swerves right by Jared, nearly clipping him! He stumbles, pulls himself up, and keeps running!

nodes.speaker: Natara Williams
nodes.text: I got him!
Natara runs after him... Right into the path of an oncoming city bus!
You grab the guy by the shoulders...

nodes.speaker: Guy
nodes.text: Hey! What's your problem, man?

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: Wrong guy!

nodes.speaker: Natara Williams
nodes.text: There! Down by the street!

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: There! Down by the street!

nodes.speaker: Natara Williams
nodes.text: FBI! Get out of the way!
You grab the guy by the shoulders...

nodes.speaker: Guy
nodes.text: Dude! What's your issue?

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: Wrong guy!

nodes.speaker: Natara Williams
nodes.text: There! Down by the street!
You grab the guy by the shoulders...

nodes.speaker: Guy
nodes.text: Hey! Let go of me, man!

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: Wrong guy!

nodes.speaker: Natara Williams
nodes.text: There! Down by the street!

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: I can't see him! There are too many people!

nodes.speaker: Natara Williams
nodes.text: There! Down by the street!

nodes.speaker: Natara Williams
nodes.text: Where is he?

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: Keep your eyes sharp!
You look for the suspect and his distinctive...

nodes.prompt: What color hair did he have?

menu.text: What color hair did he have?

nodes.text: You burst out the door after Jared, dart through a tight alley, and emerge onto a crowded street!
You duck under the pot! It clatters harmlessly behind you!
Jared sprints around the stoves and streaks out the back door!

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: Stay on him!

nodes.speaker: Natara Williams
nodes.text: I am!
You throw up your hands to block your face! The pot smashes painfully into your forearm!

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: Aggh!
Jared sprints around the stove and streaks out through the back door!

nodes.speaker: Natara Williams
nodes.text: Are you okay?!

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: Don't worry about me! Stay on Jared!
The pot clips the side of your head! Pain spikes through you, and you stumble to the floor!

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: Arrrrrgh!
Jared sprints around the stoves and streaks out through the back door!

nodes.speaker: Natara Williams
nodes.text: Are you all right?

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: Help me up. He's getting away!
Natara pulls you to your feet!
You kick the door in! It flies off its hinges in a spray of wooden splinters! You and Natara rush through!

nodes.speaker: Club Owner
nodes.text: Hey! You'd better be paying for that!
Jared races through the kitchen, speeding towards the rear exit!

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: Freeze!
Jared grabs a steel saucepot off a rack and hurls it at your head!

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: Uh... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Natara Williams
nodes.text: What's wrong with you?! He's getting away!
Natara charges forward and kicks in the door!

nodes.speaker: Natara Williams
nodes.text: Come on!
You and Natara approach an upscale nightclub in Chinatown. The words 'Zen Club' hang over the door in bright neon.

nodes.speaker: Natara Williams
nodes.text: So how'd you recognize the stamp on the girl's wrist, anyway? You don't seem like the karaoke type.

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: You're only saying that because you haven't heard me sing.

nodes.speaker: Natara Williams
nodes.text: Oh really?

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: That and I know the owner here. Shady guy, but he helped us out with an investigation a while back.
You step into the bar. It's before business hours, but a few of the staff are already setting up.

nodes.speaker: Club Owner
nodes.text: Ah crap, it's you. Listen, I already told the last cop, I have no idea how that guy was a Health Inspector...

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: Relax, Milo. This isn't about your rat infestation.

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: There's been a homicide. We have reason to believe the victim was here last night.

nodes.speaker: Natara Williams
nodes.text: We want to know about a redhead in her 20s, with a tattoo of a constellation on her lower back. That ring any bells?

nodes.speaker: Club Owner
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah, I know the one. She's a regular.

nodes.speaker: Club Owner
nodes.text: Hey, wait... Is she... You know...

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: Just tell us. Was she with anyone?

nodes.speaker: Club Owner
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah, she was talking to Jared.

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: Jared?
The owner jerks his thumb across the room. Behind the bar, a muscular young man wipes down shot glasses.

nodes.speaker: Club Owner
nodes.text: Hey, Jared! Some cops here to see you.

nodes.speaker: Jared
nodes.text: Oh, uh, just give me one sec...
Jared steps away from the bar, tosses down his towel...
...Then bolts through the kitchen door!

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: He's getting away!
You jump the bar and grab the door handle! It's locked!

nodes.speaker: Natara Williams
nodes.text: Is that the best you can do?

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: Excuse me?

nodes.speaker: Natara Williams
nodes.text: I've been in the field for three years. I've worked seven major cases, including the Owen Wiles investigation.

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: You took down the Harlem Hacker?

nodes.speaker: Natara Williams
nodes.text: From firewall to full confession. Do me a favor and leave the profiling to me, okay?

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: I guess so.
Detective Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: I'm right, aren't I? You're on crap detail.

nodes.speaker: Natara Williams
nodes.text: I'll admit I'm not on the best of terms with my District Chief...

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: I knew it! What'd you do? Blow a major lead? Get too cozy with a reporter?

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: Did you shoot someone you weren't supposed to?

nodes.speaker: Natara Williams
nodes.text: How about you leave the profiling to me, Detective?

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: All right, all right. Just keep your gun holstered around me, okay?

nodes.speaker: Natara Williams
nodes.text: I make no promises.

nodes.speaker: Natara Williams
nodes.text: Be my guest!

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: Well, if I'm not mistaken, the local FBI branch is working the Flores Cartel, their biggest organized crime takedown in fifteen years...

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: And yet you're stuck helping us with a dead Jane Doe on the waterfront.

nodes.speaker: Natara Williams
nodes.text: What are you implying?

options.label: You must have ticked someone off.

nodes.speaker: Natara Williams
nodes.text: Your name is Mal Fallon. I'm guessing that you're a descendant of Malachi Fallon, first Chief of Police of the San Francisco Police Department?

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: So you've read a history book.

nodes.speaker: Natara Williams
nodes.text: So policework runs in your blood.

nodes.speaker: Natara Williams
nodes.text: But your response to me suggests an innate distrust of women. Absent mother, I imagine?

nodes.speaker: Natara Williams
nodes.text: I'm guessing you had a rebellious youth? Didn't play by the rules? Maybe even a little legal trouble?

nodes.speaker: Natara Williams
nodes.text: And all of this culminates in a personality type that serves authority without fully respecting it.

nodes.speaker: Natara Williams
nodes.text: How'd I do?

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: Pretty good. But you're wrong about my mother. The woman was a saint.

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: Now how about I tell you what my gut thinks of you?

nodes.speaker: Natara Williams
nodes.text: Defensive, much?

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: I'm not defensive. I'd just rather not hear about how my mother was overindulgent, and that's why I like redheads.

nodes.speaker: Natara Williams
nodes.text: I actually had you pegged as more of a blonde man...

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: You want to see profiling, Special Agent Williams? How about I tell you what my gut thinks of you?
Welcome to `Cause of Death!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Welcome to [b]Cause of Death![/b]

nodes.text: You are playing as Detective Mal Fallon.
You drive your squadcar down the bumpy streets of San Francisco. Next to you sits your new partner, FBI Profiler Natara Williams.
She goes over her paperwork in stony silence.

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: Not much of a talker, are you? Too busy profiling?

nodes.speaker: Natara Williams
nodes.text: As a matter of fact, Detective, I am. And I'm not sure I understand why you find that so amusing.

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: It's just... Come on. The Maskmaker is out there killing innocent young women, and you think we're gonna catch him with some pop psychology?

nodes.speaker: Natara Williams
nodes.text: And what do `you` think is going to help us catch him?
nodes.text_bbcode: And what do [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] think is going to help us catch him?

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: Real policework. Hitting the street. Grilling witnesses. Following my gut.

nodes.speaker: Natara Williams
nodes.text: Oh please. Spare me the 'tough cop' routine, will you? I've worked with enough detectives to know it's all an act.

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: And you think you know me that well? Have you profiled me?

nodes.speaker: Natara Williams
nodes.text: As a matter of fact, Detective, I have. Would you like to hear it?
Great, but not quite `perfect.` Try again to unlock the bonus scene!
nodes.text_bbcode: Great, but not quite [b]perfect.[/b] Try again to unlock the bonus scene!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, what is this?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, Sam and I tried to create a perfect Christmas memory for you, but...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'll admit, we didn't get everything right.
$ZOE surveys the 'surprise'.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, it's the thought that counts, right? You wanted to give me a great Christmas, and that's `something...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, it's the thought that counts, right? You wanted to give me a great Christmas, and that's [color=#3b78e2][i]something...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I mean, it's nearly as good as actually `having` a great Christmas, but still, it... It... Sniffle...
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean, it's nearly as good as actually [color=#3b78e2][i]having[/i][/color] a great Christmas, but still, it... It... Sniffle...

nodes.text: $ZOE bursts into tears.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Howard... I think I need to be alone again.
$ZOE races into her room and slams the door shut.
Howard turns to Sam.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, that could've gone better.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, but it also could've gone a whole lot worse...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: At least, we know we both care about $ZOE. That's something we both share...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, it's a mutual interest...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: One might even describe it as a mutual `feeling...`
nodes.text_bbcode: One might even describe it as a mutual [color=#3b78e2][i]feeling...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: As in, the `feeling is mutual...`
nodes.text_bbcode: As in, the [color=#e23b3b][i]feeling is mutual...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Sam stares at Howard, shocked! Howard's eyes go wide! Sam tackles Howard to the couch, and the two make out!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Guys, I'm all better now. I just wanted to...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard?! Sam?! What are you two doing?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: ...Uh, CPR?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I, um... Accidentally swallowed a... Nutcracker?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's bad enough that my parents abandoned me, but `you too?!` And on Christmas!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's bad enough that my parents abandoned me, but [color=#3b78e2][i]you too?![/i][/color] And on Christmas!

nodes.text: $ZOE erupts in tears and flees back to her room.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, I was wrong... There's officially no way that could've gone worse...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: ...Yeah.
Sam says there's no way that could've been worse. We'll have to agree!
This was supposed to be a story of magic and wonderment and holiday cheer... But instead we had a failed Christmas surprise and a random hook-up!
You can do better than that. Play again to get a good ending!

args.text: Try again! We know you can do it!

nodes.text: $ZOE steps out of her bedroom and enters the living room.
Snow falls outside, a real tree laden with ornaments stands in the corner, and a small present lies beneath it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ohmygosh, Howard...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You did all this? It's `perfect...` The snow, the tree, and the gift... Wow, is that...?
nodes.text_bbcode: You did all this? It's [color=#3b78e2][i]perfect...[/i][/color] The snow, the tree, and the gift... Wow, is that...?

nodes.text: Howard picks up the tiny jewelry box and offers it to $ZOE. She unwraps the present and pulls out...
A charm in the shape of a small house sitting on a heart!
$ZOE's eyes go wide...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sniffle... Oh, Howard, this is `amazing...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Sniffle... Oh, Howard, this is [color=#3b78e2][i]amazing...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's to remind you that you have a home wherever there are people who care about you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This is so perfect. I can't believe you did all this...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, I did have some help...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Make that a `lot` of help...
nodes.text_bbcode: Make that a [color=#3b78e2][i]lot[/i][/color] of help...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE, we're not your parents, and nothing we can do will bring them here, but that doesn't mean you don't belong...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And it doesn't mean that we can't help you create new memories that you'll treasure every bit as much as the old ones.
$ZOE pulls Howard and Sam into a giant bear hug.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, guys...
Howard glances over $ZOE's shoulder and notices a power cord dangling down from the rooftop.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait a second... Sam, the snow machine, I think we forgot to plug it in.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But if you didn't plug it in, how is it...?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Whoa... You mean it's `really` snowing?
nodes.text_bbcode: Whoa... You mean it's [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] snowing?

nodes.text: Howard, $ZOE, and Sam dash outside. From overhead, a billion tiny snowflakes drift down, gleaming in the moonlight like feather-weight diamonds.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Heh. Merry Christmas, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Merry Christmas, Howard.
Howard pulls $ZOE into an embrace. He gives her a long, lingering kiss...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wow, you two are still going at it...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay... I'm going to just... Go back... Inside the house now...
Hey! Well, that was something, wasn't it! All that work, and you ended with a genuine Christmas miracle!
That must mean you played a `great` game!
nodes.text_bbcode: That must mean you played a [b]great[/b] game!

nodes.text: As Howard and Sam trudge toward Sam's house, the door bursts open and $ZOE comes flying out!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Howard, there you are! I've been calling all over trying to find you!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: ...$ZOE, wow! You seem like you're in a good mood.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I am! A little while ago, I found that my parents are flying me to Europe! I'm leaving in just a few minutes!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: ...Oh, well that's great! I mean, I'm sad that I won't be able to spend more time with you over the holidays, but as soon as you get back...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no, Howard. I'm sorry. I should've explained myself better. The ticket my parents bought me is one way. I'll be staying with them in Europe indefinitely.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You mean, like... `forever?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You mean, like... [color=#e23b3b][i]forever?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know it's sudden, and I know this will put a strain on our relationship, but it's a chance for me to spend more time with my parents and...
A taxi honks its horn!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oops! Got to run! Happy holidays, Howard! I'll miss you!
$ZOE pecks Howard on the cheek, hops in the taxi, and it peels off toward the airport.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But... But...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, on the bright side, $ZOE will get her holiday, after all, and I finally get to stretch my legs a bit. I love my cousin, but she was seriously cramping my style by living here.
